_about: helen-triages' additions to the kit's .claude/kit/settings.kit.json. python3 tools/kit/build.py merges the two into .claude/settings.json: lists are joined, a kit value cannot be changed, and an allow rule a deny covers is refused. Keys starting with _ never reach settings.json. DECISIONS §11.

_reviewedOpenRules.Bash(sh scripts/browser/shoot.sh *): A label and site paths, passed to tools/dev/shoot.js, which checks both and writes only tmp/shots/. The script sets the base URL from tmp/browser/port; no argument reaches node or the shell.
_reviewedOpenRules.Bash(sh scripts/browser/crop.sh *): Passed to tools/dev/crop.js, which checks label, selector, page and its --width/--engine/--click/--type-into options and writes only tmp/shots/.
_reviewedOpenRules.Bash(sh scripts/browser/styles.sh *): Passed to tools/dev/styles.js, which checks selector, page and --props/--width/--engine and writes nothing.
_reviewedOpenRules.Bash(sh scripts/browser/gaps.sh *): Passed to tools/dev/gaps.js, which checks selector, page and --width/--depth/--engine and writes nothing.
_reviewedOpenRules.Bash(sh scripts/browser/click-crop.sh *): Passed to tools/dev/crop.js as its selectors, label, page, --width and --click, which crop.js checks; writes only tmp/shots/.
